what: Covers of the company risk report (/it/rapporto, /risk-report; owner, 21 Nov 2026: «PDF-файл бюллетень… с рисками, с эстимейшенами, с иллюстрациями под конкретную компанию»). One scene for each kind of crossing, chosen by the first lane of the link (site/assets/rapporto.js, cover). In each Zholdas measures something: estimating is the report's subject. New scene types, used nowhere else: a surveyor's level by an Alpine motorway, a lantern at a tunnel portal, an anemometer on a ferry quay. He looks at his instrument, not at the viewer. The world fills the frame and runs out through every edge.
processing: 2688x1520 PNG resized to 1600 and 900 wide, WebP q82; og.jpg is the Alpine cover at 1200 wide, cropped to 1200x630, JPEG q84, no text on it

alpi.for: Brenner, Tauern, Tarvisio, Slovenia and any other lane
alpi.scene: a felt Alpine valley, a motorway on a viaduct with two trucks, a freight train beside it; Zholdas looks through a brass surveyor's level on a tripod, a rolled paper under his arm

tunnel.scene: a snowy tunnel portal with an amber signal lamp, a truck waiting; Zholdas holds up a brass lantern and a folded plan, looking at the portal

mare.scene: a ferry harbour on a strait, a truck boarding over the bow ramp, a stretched wind sock; Zholdas holds up a brass cup anemometer and looks at it

alternatives_not_used.852e1d1c-f4b4-4f69-8a6d-f59368fc4ba8: the same scene, but the vest had three stripes instead of two

prompt_start: The exact same handmade plush toy character as in the reference images (Zholdas), with exactly the same proportions as the references … A wide three-dimensional handmade felt toy world that fills the whole frame from edge to edge … The land, the road and the rails are cut off by the frame edges and continue beyond them; no island, no border, no vignette. A calm pale cream-blue sky fills the upper left third of the frame … No helmet, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no license plates, no flags, no other characters.
